arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, and it's great that you've made your contact email easy to find. A couple of suggestions: you could add a short introduction about yourself, some info on what you do, and maybe a few links or a portfolio section to make the site more engaging. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's lovely that you share your passion for hiking! To make it even better, you could add some posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, and tips for fellow hikers. That would really bring your blog to life. Keep it up!
